The '''Sakuub Holocron''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] that was present on the ground near the ruins of the [[Sky Temple of Karsol]]. [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] suspected that it contained information regarding [[Abeloth]] that the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] could utilize it should she return. However, an unknown group intended to gain the Holocron as well.
